headline: Lincoln finish the season unbeaten
dek: Lincoln beat Truman, the side that had held them to a draw in September, in their last match of the season, and close their schedule with fifteen wins, four draws and no defeat. Across all their matches they conceded twelve goals.
displaced_by: The old dek said Lincoln won on the season's last day, which is no longer true because Maryville v Drury is still to be played. The headline stands and the dek is corrected to say it was Lincoln's last match.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have lost four times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, and at home to Lincoln and to Missouri-St. Louis in October.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has twelve of Lincoln's forty-two goals, from sixty-nine shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Panagos, a midfielder, has fifteen of Truman's twenty-eight goals, from fifty-seven shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Lincoln have now won every match they played at home this season.

next_match.line: The two sides are level in the table behind Lincoln, and drew when they met in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
